verdict.rationale: Warp's first-party docs say MCP servers extend its local agents as plugins exposing custom tools and data sources, and the marketing page describes connecting Warp AI to any tool via the Model Context Protocol. MCP support also extends to the Oz CLI, which can connect agents to MCP servers such as GitHub and Linear. Agent profiles add control over which MCP servers an agent may use. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of MCP tool use, and detailed docs on setup and transports (e.g., stdio vs. remote, configuration format).
